description: Defines the RocketColorInput class, a custom UI element for color input handling in the game, including event processing and DOM manipulation.

classes.name: RocketColorInput
classes.description: A custom UI element for color input, handling user interactions and visual updates.

methods.name: RocketColorInput
methods.description: Constructor initializing the element with a tag.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of child elements, initializes input and color display elements.

methods.description: Passes attribute changes to the input element.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Handles click, change, and blur events to toggle display and update value.
